Area.evidence_source: Our findings support previous studies that substance abuse is related to suicidal behaviour both as problem-focused and emotional-focused coping and as a means of suicide ideation and suicide attempts (Rotheram-Borus, 1993; Molnar, Shade, Kral, Booth & Watters, 1998).;When they found this to be possible, for example, by fighting against dominating social structures or fleeing from overwhelming situations, problemfocused coping dominated.;They decided to seek treatment for their dependency and psychosocial problems.;Mahmood could enjoy a more positive emotion-focused coping first when he engaged in dual treatment, addressing his dependency and his psychosocial problems at the same time.
